Messages.Author: RoddimusPrime
Messages.Body:
Alright, so I already built the deck a long time ago featuring Daughters and Shattering Crescendo. On it's first outing it went to the finals and came close to victory. My only question is what kind of cool cards or combos or essentials are something you would think of beyond the obvious.

My deck featured Shattering Crescendo, Sirens Lure, Missing Voice, Catatonic Fear + Target Vitals, Concert Tour, Fear of Mekhet, Society of Leopold, Dragonbound, and Fame.

I would love to hear some good ideas for this deck.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Virtuosa is a great card. I was very dubious until I played it, but it always allowed me to get some VP. (Yeah, it's 3 blood).

I'm a big fan of the combo Siren's Lure + Catatonic Fear + Target Vitals, because you can put 9 damage in one action.

I added Edward Vignes to my deck to get some defense against stealth bleed decks without having to back-shatter during the early game.

I'm also trying the Anarch angle to benefit from Anarch Railroad for permanent stealth (in addition to Paris Opera House).
